decisive_items: homogeneously hyperintense on both T1-weighted and T2-weighted sequences, suggestive of fat
posterior epidural mass from D5 to D7
ascending spastic weakness of the lower limbs
response.rationale: The MRI finding of a posterior epidural fat-signal mass is highly specific for spinal epidural lipomatosis and explains the compressive myelopathy; the other candidate is only a generic consequence, not the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Describes spinal cord compression as a syndrome rather than identifying the causative epidural fat mass and lacks the specific radiologic diagnosis.
